data.why: The tool is fully self-contained; a scientist types their own compound names, concentrations, volumes and solubility limits directly into the form, there is no file to upload or example dataset to load.

goals: Enter target concentrations, volumes and a solubility limit for a compound and generate a multi-stage dilution scheme
Work out the required common stock concentration from the highest target concentration and the overall dilution factor
Check whether the required stock concentration exceeds the compound's solubility limit
Set a minimum pipetting volume and maximum per-step dilution factor and let the tool auto-insert intermediate dilutions that keep every transfer pipettable
Lay out experimental groups and replicates on a 96-well plate alongside the dilution protocol
Export the finished protocol, material list, preparation procedure and plate layout as CSV, PDF or image for use at the bench

review.summary: The tree captures the purpose the README states: turn target concentrations into a pipettable multi-stage dilution plan with a stock/solubility check, reserve-aware volumes, a plate layout and exports. The screens I sampled support it and the replay confirmed every node. It needs small cleanups before filing: one screen that doesn't show the CSV it is cited for, misplaced actions, a vague t8 label, and PDF export flagged as unverified.
